description: This file defines the ConceptAttributeType class, which extends BaseAttributeType<Concept> and implements AttributeType<Concept>. It includes an identifier property with getter and setter methods, and overrides getId/setId methods.

classes.name: ConceptAttributeType
classes.description: Represents an attribute type for concepts, extending BaseAttributeType and implementing AttributeType interface. It is annotated with @Audited for Hibernate Envers auditing.

methods.name: getConceptAttributeTypeId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this ConceptAttributeType.

methods.name: setConceptAttributeTypeId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this ConceptAttributeType.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Overrides the getId method to return the concept attribute type ID.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Overrides the setId method to set the concept attribute type ID.
